items.source: Consider the following domain model where User.name is annotated with @Unwrapped. The @Unwrapped annotation signals that all properties of UserName should be flattened out into the user document that owns the name property.
items.translation: 考虑以下领域模型，其中User.name 已标注@Unwrapped。@Unwrapped 注解表示应将UserName 的所有属性扁平化到拥有name 属性的user 文档中。

items.source: For less verbose embeddable type declarations use @Unwrapped.Nullable and @Unwrapped.Empty instead @Unwrapped(onEmpty = USE_NULL) and @Unwrapped(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY). Both annotations are meta-annotated with JSR-305 @javax.annotation.Nonnull to aid with nullability inspections.
items.translation: 对于更简洁的可嵌入类型声明，请使用 `@Unwrapped.Nullable` 和 `@Unwrapped.Empty` 替代 `@Unwrapped(onEmpty = USE_NULL)` 和 `@Unwrapped(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY)`。 这两个注解均通过 JSR-305 的 `@javax.annotation.Nonnull` 进行元注解，以辅助空值检查。

items.source: A value object can be unwrapped multiple times by using the optional prefix attribute of the @Unwrapped annotation. By dosing so the chosen prefix is prepended to each property or @Field("…") name in the unwrapped object. Please note that values will overwrite each other if multiple properties render to the same field name.
items.translation: 值对象可以通过使用 `@Unwrapped` 注解的可选 `prefix` 属性进行多次解包。通过这样做，所选的前缀将被追加到解包对象中的每个属性或 `@Field("…")` 名称之前。请注意，如果多个属性渲染为相同的字段名，它们的值将相互覆盖。

items.source: While combining the @Field annotation with @Unwrapped on the very same property does not make sense and therefore leads to an error. It is a totally valid approach to use @Field on any of the unwrapped types properties.
items.translation: 将 `@Field` 注解与同一属性上的 `@Unwrapped` 注解结合使用既无意义，也会导致错误。 在任何被展开（unwrapped）的类型属性上使用 `@Field` 是完全有效的做法。

items.source: It is possible to attach the @Indexed annotation to properties of an unwrapped type just as it is done with regular objects. It is not possible to use @Indexed along with the @Unwrapped annotation on the owning property.
items.translation: 可以将 `@Indexed` 注解附加到未包装类型的属性上，就像对普通对象那样操作。 不能在拥有者属性上同时使用 `@Indexed` 和 `@Unwrapped` 注解。

items.source: Unwrapped objects can be used within an Example probe just as any other type. Please review the Query By Example section, to learn more about this feature.
items.translation: 未包装的对象可以在 `Example` 探针中像任何其他类型一样使用。请查阅按示例查询部分，以了解更多关于此功能的信息。

items.source: Index creation for unwrapped objects is suspended even if the repository create-query-indexes namespace attribute is set to true.
items.translation: 即使仓库的 `create-query-indexes` 命名空间属性设置为 `true`，未包装对象的索引创建也会被挂起。

items.source: Defining queries on unwrapped properties is possible on type- as well as field-level as the provided Criteria is matched against the domain type. Prefixes and potential custom field names will be considered when rendering the actual query. Use the property name of the unwrapped object to match against all contained fields as shown in the sample below.
items.translation: 在类型级别和字段级别上，都可以对未包装的属性定义查询，因为提供的 Criteria 会与域类型进行匹配。 在生成实际查询时，会考虑前缀和潜在的自定义字段名称。 请使用未包装对象的属性名来匹配其包含的所有字段，如下面的示例所示。

items.source: The Repository abstraction allows deriving queries on fields of unwrapped objects as well as the entire object.
items.translation: `Repository` 抽象允许对解包对象的字段以及整个对象进行查询推导。

items.source: The Aggregation Framework will attempt to map unwrapped values of typed aggregations. Please make sure to work with the property path including the wrapper object when referencing one of its values. Other than that no special action is required.
items.translation: 聚合框架（Aggregation Framework）将尝试映射已解包的类型化聚合值。在引用其某个值时，请确保使用包含包装对象的属性路径。除此之外，无需采取任何特殊操作。

items.source: Unwrapped entities are used to design value objects in your Java domain model whose properties are flattened out into the parent’s MongoDB Document.
items.translation: 未包装的实体用于在 Java 领域模型中设计值对象，其属性会被扁平化并合并到父级 MongoDB 文档中。

items.source:
It is possible to use complex types within an unwrapped object.
However, those must not be, nor contain unwrapped fields themselves.
items.translation:
可以在未包装对象中使用复杂类型。  
但是，这些类型本身不能是未包装字段，也不能包含未包装字段。

items.source: It is also possible to address any field of the unwrapped object directly using its property name as shown in the snippet below.
items.translation: 同样，也可以使用属性名直接访问解包对象的任意字段，如下所示的代码片段。

items.source: Fields of unwrapped objects can be used for sorting via their property path as shown in the sample below.
items.translation: 未包装对象的字段可以通过其属性路径进行排序，如下面的示例所示。

items.source: Though possible, using the unwrapped object itself as sort criteria includes all of its fields in unpredictable order and may result in inaccurate ordering.
items.translation: 虽然可行，但直接使用未包装的对象本身作为排序标准会包含其所有字段且顺序不可预测，可能导致排序不准确。

items.source: Fields of unwrapped objects can be subject for projection either as a whole or via single fields as shown in the samples below.
items.translation: 未包装对象的字段可以整体进行投影，也可以像以下示例中所示通过单个字段进行投影。

items.source:
Unwrapped objects can be updated as any other object that is part of the domain model.
The mapping layer takes care of flattening structures into their surroundings.
It is possible to update single attributes of the unwrapped object as well as the entire value as shown in the examples below.
items.translation: 未包装的对象可以像领域模型中的任何其他对象一样进行更新。映射层负责将结构扁平化到其周围环境中。如下面的示例所示，既可以更新未包装对象的单个属性，也可以更新整个值。
